sections.title: Summary
blocks: Code are delighted to present Hunter Douglas Benelux with this statement of work to deliver the Brightvale Elevate website builds for the following existing URLs:

bullets: [https://www.brightvale.nl/](https://www.brightvale.nl/)
[https://www.brightvale.be/](https://www.brightvale.be/)

blocks: URLs to be used for the new sites:

bullets: Brightvale.com/nl
Brightvale.com/be – 2 x languages (Dutch and French)

blocks: Following the successful launch of the Elevate platform across Hunter Douglas brands, Brightvale is the next brand to be added to the platform. This SoW covers the design and build activities required to deliver these websites. Both locales will share one set of Brightvale design tokens, delivered within the already agreed design token governance guidelines.

This proposal has been costed at a total of [TBC: fixed cost] as agreed in the Elevate pitch process costs. It includes the existing 23% rate card discount resulting in a day rate of £670. The work will be delivered on a fixed cost basis meaning that Hunter Douglas will be invoiced against the billing plan included in this document.
If you have any questions on this document, please contact Claire Kerley on 0161 276 2080 or [claire.kerley@wppmedia.com](mailto:claire.kerley@wppmedia.com)

sections.title: Project Overview
blocks: Brightvale.com/nl and Brightvale.com/be are the next brand locales to be built on the new Elevate platform, taking in the benefits of using Prismic the SaaS based CMS to enable the Hunter Douglas content editors to manage website content, features and functionality internally.

This removes the reliance on any further intensive development effort once the sites are launched. This project will deliver a consistent front-end user experience with consistent features and functionality using existing components from the global component library, with a new set of Brightvale design tokens to deliver the brand look and feel across both locales.
It’s assumed that both locales will be launched at 100% with no traffic split for go live.

sections.title: Scope of work
blocks: The following deliverables are in scope for this statement of work:

As part of the Brightvale website builds, a new set of design tokens will be produced for the brand but these will be in keeping with the already agreed design token governance set up. One set of tokens will be applied across both locales.
Fonts to be used are: [TBC: heading font] (Headings) + [TBC: body font] (body)

It is also anticipated that the Hunter Douglas Benelux team will support the local teams on which components to use for which pages. No design consultancy or production of page designs are included within the scope of this statement of work.

bullets.detail: Architect and implement dev, test, staging and prod pipelines for Brightvale.com/nl and Brightvale.com/be in line with existing streamlined updates and deployments.
Set up a dedicated Prismic repository instance for Brightvale, with the NL and BE (Dutch and French) locales.
Configure CI/CD pipelines to automate deployment and content publishing workflows.
Provision and configure cloud infrastructure to support the new websites.
Configuration within the existing infrastructure for optimal performance and security.
Code will work with the HD team to agree what level of automation will be needed for Brightvale, delivered as part of the build feature tickets.
